entities.name: Pierre Pruvost
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pierre Eugène Marie Joseph Pruvost was a French geologist who worked as a professor of geology at the University of Lille. He was a specialist on the fossil fauna and flora of the coal basins of Europe.
